decisions.rationale: ROOT reproduced the closed-schema contradiction directly in the current production code: the call chain is required to carry stage but the generic verifier rejects that required key. This blocks all valid limitation admissions. The one-call projection preserves both closed contracts and has materially lower complexity, regression risk, and verification cost than leaving the required path unusable.
decisions.smallest_fix: Pass only path and sha256 from each already-shape-validated call-chain item into the generic reference verifier; retain all stage/order/identity/predecessor checks unchanged.
